title: Parents see a hooded being in their bedroom

tellings.quote: But my parents um saw a bean in their bedroom one night. Okay. hooded bean in their bedroom, which we never I never knew until Ray Fowler interviewed her.

plain: A man named Jim Weiner, who tells of his own strange experiences, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the 1950s, near Allentown, Pennsylvania, his parents saw a hooded being in their bedroom one night. He says he never knew about it until Ray Fowler, a UFO investigator, interviewed his mother. If true, it would mean such visits ran in his family before his own.
